scannedKeywords.findings: Passwords are properly stored as secure salted BCrypt hashes in JSON/PostgreSQL databases. Form elements use appropriate secure fields (type='password'). Insecure fallback default passwords and credentials in codebase files have been completely removed and redacted.
All process.env fallbacks for JWT secrets have been entirely purged. JWT keys are now read exclusively from the process environment with strict validation during app startup.

Authentication session tokens and refresh tokens are securely generated using independent cryptographically strong secrets. Access tokens expire in 2 hours; refresh tokens expire in 7 days and are checked against DB/JSON session tables.
No hardcoded API keys found. Third-party integrations (such as Google GenAI) use standard process environment bindings with no default fallbacks.

JWT generation utilizes unique secrets for access tokens and refresh tokens (JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET respectively). Token payload verification strictly avoids trusting user-supplied headers, retrieving context metadata exclusively from validated claims.

securityWeaknessesMitigated.description: JWT_SECRET was assigned a default string 'alkaswa-super-secret-jwt-key-2026' when the environment variable was missing.
securityWeaknessesMitigated.mitigation: Removed all hardcoded fallback values for JWT_SECRET and JWT_REFRESH_SECRET in server.ts and rbacEngine.ts. Keys are now strictly loaded from the environment.

securityWeaknessesMitigated.description: DEFAULT_DATABASE_URL containing the plain text password 'secured_pass' was hardcoded as a fallback in dbClient.ts and verifyProductionInfrastructure.ts.
securityWeaknessesMitigated.mitigation: Completely removed plain text credentials and redacted fallback string to a REDACTED placeholder. Database URLs are now strictly parsed from process.env with no fallback.

securityWeaknessesMitigated.vulnerability: Lack of Startup Environment Integrity Check
securityWeaknessesMitigated.description: The application could start up without critical environment variables (e.g. DATABASE_URL, JWT secrets) and default to insecure fallback states in production.
securityWeaknessesMitigated.mitigation: Created /startup/securityValidation.ts to validate the presence of DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, JWT_REFRESH_SECRET, and NODE_ENV. The server immediately halts with an exit code 1 in production if any secrets are missing.

securityWeaknessesMitigated.vulnerability: Brute Force Susceptibility on Authentication APIs
securityWeaknessesMitigated.description: Login and token refresh endpoints had no transaction rate-limiting, allowing malicious brute-force attempts.
securityWeaknessesMitigated.mitigation: Integrated express-rate-limit middleware on /api/auth/login and /api/auth/refresh to throttle requests per IP to a maximum of 100 requests per 15 minutes.

securityWeaknessesMitigated.description: Missing modern security headers like Content Security Policy (CSP), XSS protection, MIME sniffing protection, and clickjacking defense.
securityWeaknessesMitigated.mitigation: Configured Helmet middleware with safe and compatible Content Security Policy, CORS configuration to restrict origin access to verified preview and deployment domains, and clickjacking protections tailored for Google AI Studio context.
